summary: Warm, earthy, and undeniably chic. This rich brownish-red lipstick offers a trendy, 90s-inspired hue with an ultra-smooth, creamy glide.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 3.5g, this KoColor LIPSTICK is expertly formulated with Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Beeswax, Silica, Iron Oxides, Yellow 6 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Terracotta Brick color profile (`#8B3A3A`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
